episodeTitle.en: Meta’s Muse: How we launched the most successful consumer product this year | Mona Sarantakos
episodeTitle.zh: Meta 的 Muse：我们如何推出今年最成功的消费产品｜Mona Sarantakos

guestBioOfficial.zh: Mona Sarantakos 是 Meta Superintelligence Labs 的产品副总裁，从 Muse 项目第一天起就负责产品。受访时她在 Meta 已有十年、做产品超过二十年。她特别关注普通消费者第一次使用 AI 时会卡在哪里。
guestBioOfficial.en: Mona is VP of Product at Meta Superintelligence Labs and led Muse from day one. At the time of the interview she had spent ten years at Meta and more than twenty in product. Her focus is where AI succeeds or fails for everyday consumers.

title.en: Meta’s Muse: How we launched the most successful consumer product this year | Mona Sarantakos
title.zh: Meta 的 Muse：我们如何推出今年最成功的消费产品｜Mona Sarantakos

summary.zh: 从周末试用 OpenClaw 到 Muse 发布，Mona 讲了哪些反馈改变了产品、团队为什么花时间观察普通人的任务，以及发布后扩编带来的难题。这也是一份关于如何在做东西越来越快时守住质量的复盘。
summary.en: Mona retraces Muse from early OpenClaw experiments to launch. She explains how conversations and everyday tasks shaped the product, then looks at the quality and staffing decisions that become harder after a launch.

insights.title: 把产品评审留给还没有说清楚的问题
insights.detail: Mona 回忆，原定半小时的讨论有时会持续一小时。来自几位决策者的反复追问，实实在在改变了最终产品的样子。
insights.detailEn: Repeated conversations with several decision-makers changed the shape of Muse, sometimes running well beyond a scheduled review.

insights.title: 生成和部署越容易，越要有人守住使用标准
insights.detail: 她在招 PM 时看重能否理解用户需求，并把这种理解变成质量标准。今天做得出来，仍不能说明消费者明天会再用。
insights.detailEn: Mona values PMs who can communicate user needs and set a quality bar, especially when producing and deploying a feature is easy.
insights.titleEn: Set the quality bar for consumers

insights.title: 小队伍发布后也需要缓冲
insights.detail: 团队小有利于保持紧密联系，但成员容易缺觉，也没人能补位。Muse 发布后开始适度扩编，难题是怎样在扩编时保留早期的默契。
insights.detailEn: A small launch team trades cohesion for little slack or cover. After launch, Muse began adding people while trying to preserve its working culture.

related.reason: 对照 Airbnb 的做法，看领导者亲自参与产品细节如何影响决策。
related.reasonEn: Compare how a leader’s involvement in product details shaped decisions at Airbnb.
